Class ScatterPlotsTransmitter

java.lang.Object
sysmlinjava.views.common.UDPTransmitter2<ScatterPlotDefinition, ScatterPlotData>
sysmlinjava.views.scatterplots.ScatterPlotsTransmitter
public class ScatterPlotsTransmitter extends UDPTransmitter2<ScatterPlotDefinition, ScatterPlotData>
The ScatterPlotsTransmitter is a specialization of the UDPTransmitter2 to transmit graph data to a ScatterPlotsReceiver for the display of graph data. This class simply uses the UDPTransmitter2's transmit0(Object) and transmit1(Object) operations to transmit the ScatterPlotDefinition and ScatterPlotData objects via the UDPTransmitter2's generic transmit operations.

      public ScatterPlotsTransmitter(int udpPort, boolean logToConsole)
      Constructur with UDP port specification
      Parameters:
      udpPort - UDP port which to transmit plot data to
      logToConsole - whether to send all transmit() logs to console. Note: transmit() operation can log every object's toString() string to the console. The more frequently log messages are sent to console, the greater the CPU resources are needed. This can cause noticable slowing of the console display and related applications.
